hypothesis: A second 100-step pass over 800 previously unseen dense LIBERO windows will increase the fixed val40 action-loss improvement from 0.453% to at least 0.75% while keeping video loss below the untrained initialization.
single_variable: Continue the E17 shared-H3 tail-2 checkpoint for exactly 100 optimizer steps on the next 800 manifest windows; architecture, loss, optimizer, noise schedule and validation stay fixed.
parent_baseline: E17 /mnt/h3-wam/outputs/h3-lingbot-shared/multiwindow_tail2_s100.pt; fixed val40 video/action losses 0.165861607/1.250916818 versus initialization 0.169533810/1.256608519.

references.title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control

architecture.paper: video and action streams are jointly modeled
architecture.upstream_code: noisy/clean video/action use the same Wan block stack
architecture.local: all four streams use the same 50 H3 blocks; only H3 tail-2 and action adapters are trainable
architecture.rationale: This is an H3 backbone port; H3 replaces Wan while preserving shared-block ownership and causal stream masking.

data.upstream_code: LeRobot action segments paired with video latent segments
data.local: next 800 unique rows from 200779-window train manifest; fixed episode-disjoint val40
data.rationale: Dense windows and the validation split are unchanged from the positive parent; the offset prevents replay of its first 800 rows.

action.upstream_code: seven active normalized LIBERO dimensions in a masked carrier
action.rationale: Inactive carrier dimensions have no loss or policy content.

objective.upstream_code: video latent velocity MSE plus masked action velocity MSE
objective.local: future-video and action velocity MSE with independent shifted timesteps
objective.rationale: Both train noise-minus-clean velocity targets under linear interpolation.

optimization.local: AdamW, lr 1e-6, global batch 8, exactly 100 additional steps, no restart warmup
optimization.rationale: The parent completed warmup; evidence rules cap this incremental canary at 100 steps before another held-out decision.

evaluation.local: same-noise episode-disjoint val40 before any rollout
evaluation.rationale: This canary only tests whether the weak offline signal scales; it cannot establish policy success.
